coach_verdict: Focus on Priority 1 (Zone 2 Aerobic Base Cycling). Given your current low CTL (7.65) and recent inactivity, an aerobic cycling session provides the cleanest high-yield aerobic stimulus to rebuild your baseline with zero impact stress, preserving your joints while starting your progressive CTL build.

priority_1.workout_details: 60 minutes continuous indoor or outdoor ride strictly in Zone 2. Warm up 10 min, 45 min steady Zone 2 at 85-95 RPM, 5 min cool down.
priority_1.reason: Safely initiates the CTL rebuild target (+1-2 CTL/week) without impact stress on detrained connective tissues, leveraging your strong e-bike commuting foundation.

priority_2.workout_details: 4x6 Barbell Back Squats (70-80kg), 3x8 Deadlifts (80-90kg), 3x10 Overhead Press, 3x12 Bench Press, 3x15 Bicep Curls & Core Sandbag Holds (70kg).
priority_2.reason: Builds posterior chain torque for cycling power and core stability for running economy while fulfilling upper-body aesthetic targets without adding cardiovascular fatigue.

priority_3.workout_details: 5km easy Zone 2 run at smooth, conversational pace. Finish with 4x15-second controlled Zone 4 acceleration strides on flat ground with 45s walking recovery.
priority_3.reason: Provides sport-specific running volume for your 5km goal while maintaining the 70/30 pyramidal distribution and introducing minimal neuromuscular speed work.
